en.bdb: Rare behave according to the wisdom of the Guru

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਸਾਣੀ ਕਿਰਸਾਣ ਕਰਿ ਖੇਤ ਬੀਜਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਨ ਲਹੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: kirasaanee kirasaan kar khet beej sukh fal na laha(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Farmers even having done their farming donot attain the fruit of spiritual Leasure.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਨਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੀਏ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਨ ਵਸੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: vanaj karan vaapaare'e lai laahaa nij ghar na vasa(n)dhe|

en.bdb: The traders engaged in profitable trading donot remain stablized theirselves.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਾਕਰ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਨ ਸੁਲਹ ਕਰੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: chaakar kar kar chaakaree haumai maar na suleh kara(n)dhe|

en.bdb: The servants go on doing their jobs but not eschewing ego Alley donot meet the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆਂ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਤਬ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: pu(n)n dhaan cha(n)giaaieeaa(n) kar kar karatab thir na raha(n)dhe|

en.bdb: People, despite their virtues and charities and .even performing many duties donot remain stablized.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੇ ਪਰਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵਾਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਵੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: raaje paraje hoi kai kar kar vaadh na paar pava(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Becoming rulers And subjects, people undertake many quarrels but donot go across the world wean.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰੁਸਿਖ ਹੋਇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮੇਲ ਮਿਲੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: gur sikh sun gurusikh hoi saadhasa(n)gat kar mel mila(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Sikhs of the Guru, adopt teachings of the Guru, and joining the holy congregation attain that supreme Lord.
Only rare ones behave in accordance with the wisdom of the Guru, the Gurmati.
